name: S H Kelkar and Company Limited

facts.business: S H Kelkar and Company Limited operates in the flavours and fragrances (F&F) industry, manufacturing fragrance and flavour ingredients for consumer-facing sectors such as personal care, home care, food and beverages.
key_risks: Dependence on key end-use categories (personal care, home care, food and beverages)
facts.related_party_note: The Group has transactions with subsidiaries including Keva Flavours Private Limited, Keva Fragrances Private Limited, Keva Fragrance Industries Pte. Ltd., Keva Europe B.V., Keva Ventures Private Limited, Keva Middle East Fze, and Keva USA Inc.
